records.english: I'll take command from the front in boarding combat.
records.source_meaning: Maria says she will take the lead position and command during boarding combat.
records.localization_note: I'll take command from the front in boarding combat retains both leadership and being at the front. It does not turn the plan into a completed attack or invent troop numbers, a new service rank or an enemy.
